description: Source code for a C library implementing dynamic strings (SDS - Simple Dynamic Strings) with various string manipulation functions, including creation, duplication, concatenation, trimming, splitting, formatting, and comparison.

methods.name: sdsnewlen
methods.description: Creates a new sds string with specified content and length, optionally initializing with zero bytes if init is NULL.

methods.name: sdsempty
methods.description: Creates an empty (zero length) sds string with null terminator.

methods.name: sdsnew
methods.description: Creates a new sds string from a null-terminated C string.

methods.name: sdsdup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing sds string.

methods.name: sdsfree
methods.description: Frees an sds string.

methods.name: sdsupdatelen
methods.description: Updates the length of an sds string based on strlen(), adjusting free space accordingly.

methods.name: sdsclear
methods.description: Resets an sds string to empty, preserving buffer for future use.

methods.name: sdsMakeRoomFor
methods.description: Enlarges the free space at the end of an sds string to accommodate additional data.

methods.name: sdsRemoveFreeSpace
methods.description: Reallocates the sds string to remove free space at the end.

methods.name: sdsAllocSize
methods.description: Returns total allocated size of an sds string including header, data, free space, and null terminator.

methods.name: sdsIncrLen
methods.description: Increments or decrements the length of an sds string, updating null terminator.

methods.name: sdsgrowzero
methods.description: Grows an sds string to a specified length, initializing new bytes to zero.

methods.name: sdscatlen
methods.description: Appends binary-safe data of specified length to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscat
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated C string to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscatsds
methods.description: Appends one sds string to another.

methods.name: sdscpylen
methods.description: Replaces sds string content with binary-safe data of specified length.

methods.name: sdscpy
methods.description: Replaces sds string content with a null-terminated C string.

methods.name: sdsll2str
methods.description: Converts a long long integer to string, storing result in provided buffer.

methods.name: sdsull2str
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long long integer to string, storing result in provided buffer.

methods.name: sdsfromlonglong
methods.description: Creates an sds string from a long long integer.

methods.name: sdscatvprintf
methods.description: Appends formatted string using va_list to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscatprintf
methods.description: Appends formatted string to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscatfmt
methods.description: Appends formatted string with limited printf-like specifiers for performance.

methods.name: sdstrim
methods.description: Trims characters in cset from both ends of an sds string.

methods.name: sdsrange
methods.description: Extracts a substring from an sds string based on start and end indices.

methods.name: sdstolower
methods.description: Converts all characters in an sds string to lowercase.

methods.name: sdstoupper
methods.description: Converts all characters in an sds string to uppercase.

methods.name: sdscmp
methods.description: Compares two sds strings lexicographically.

methods.name: sdssplitlen
methods.description: Splits a binary-safe string into tokens based on a separator with length.

methods.name: sdsfreesplitres
methods.description: Frees array of sds tokens returned by sdssplitlen.

methods.name: sdscatrepr
methods.description: Appends an escaped representation of a string, with special characters escaped.

methods.name: sdssplitargs
methods.description: Splits a line into arguments, supporting quoted strings and escape sequences.

methods.name: sdsmapchars
methods.description: Replaces characters in an sds string based on from-to mapping.

methods.name: sdsjoin
methods.description: Joins an array of C strings with a separator into a single sds string.
